create_transformer_set_output: create a StandardScaler transformer that outputs pandas DataFrames by calling set_output on the estimator
configure_pipeline_set_output: configure a sklearn pipeline to output pandas DataFrames for all steps using set_output on the pipeline
configure_global_transform_output: configure all sklearn transformers globally to output pandas DataFrames using set_config with transform_output
use_config_context_transform_output: use config_context to temporarily configure transform output as pandas for a block of code
build_column_transformer_pipeline: build a ColumnTransformer pipeline with heterogeneous data and set_output for pandas DataFrame output
